objective: A mains-powered indoor environment monitor that samples temperature, humidity and air quality, shows readings on a local display, and reports them over Wi-Fi
functional_requirements: sample temperature and humidity from an I2C sensor
sample particulate/air-quality from a second I2C sensor
drive a small SPI display with current readings
accept a UART GPS module for site tagging
2 momentary push buttons for mode and reset
3 status LEDs for power, network and alert
report readings to a cloud endpoint over Wi-Fi
